Why I love cooking

Cooking is how I relax after a long week. I started the blog in 2015 as a way to keep track of the meals my family loved, and it has slowly grown into something I never expected. This post is about the kitchen habits that make cooking calmer: planning on Sundays, tasting as you go, and keeping a good knife sharp.

Next week I will share a few of my favourite weeknight dinners. Until then, happy cooking!
